notes.title: Update 1/5/19
notes.notes:
In this update, a new Battle has been introduced: Giant Battle. Now you can throw at other players supersized pieces and see how they deal with them! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/181e71f47df9b2b8ab6056c7c7280f00207dc078.png[/img]

Other changes to the game include:
[list]
[*] Now you can play the game within a resizable windowed.
[*] Initial rotation of the L and J pieces was changed.
[*] The rotation system has been tweaked to allow more SRS twists.
[*] The was an exploit were that game would detect a 180-rotation as a twist (when it wasn't). It has also been fixed.
[*] Some other minor bugs have been fixed as well.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 13/4/2019
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Changed the S and Z colors (they were swapped)
[*] Cheese now works as intended on online
[*] Combo gamemode now works on online
[*] Fixed several typos on the lobby screen and on the menu tooltips
[*] Fixed the Left and Right rotations (they were inversed)
[*] Fixed some online sync errors that would sometimes occur
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*] The battle bar of the other players in online multiplayer is now visible
[*] Rebalanced most battles (especially Cubic Battle and Copy Battle).
[*] Added soud effects to some power-ups
[*] Added an in-game link to the [url=https://discord.gg/bM2KUa2]official Discord server[/url].
[*] Removed the Global Chat system.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 20/1/2019
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added the option to turn off piece trails.
[*] Tweaked some visual issues regarding pop-up texts.
[/list]

notes.title: Global Chat Update
notes.notes: A [b]Global Chat[/b] has been added in order to improve matchmaking and make it easier for players to find other players online. The chat shows the number of connected players at the time. It also flashes when a new message is received.

notes.title: Patch 13/1/2019
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the Quick Join button to not do anything.
[*] Fixed a bug that would make the Friends Only lobbies to not be joinable by anyone.
[*] Added a 'Lobby List' header on top of the actual lobby list.
[/list]

This is how said header looks:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/987e97ed8cb3b8b9b13cdc96cf086dfc0834a7da.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 10/1/2019
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Introduced a new feature: [b]Preview[/b]. This lets you change the number of pieces visible below the [b]Next[/b] sign.
[*] Tweaked the [b]Hypersplit[/b] pieceset.
[*] Added two new piecesets: [b]Lite Pentominos[/b] and [b]Lite Pentasplit[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 9/1/2019
notes.notes:
Fixed a couple of bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the settings wouldn't automatically save.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the first ghost piece in a game not render properly.
[/list]
